headline: Lewiatan criticizes CIT hike: 'It may limit funds for investment'
summary: Konfederacja Lewiatan said the government's proposed corporate income tax increase for some companies may weaken investment and add tax uncertainty. It also said PIT changes may reduce wage growth pressure.
why: Corporate income tax rates affect company cash flows and investment decisions, and business lobby groups such as Lewiatan represent employers in Poland.

original_headline: Lewiatan krytykuje podwyżkę CIT. "Może ograniczyć środki na inwestycje"
